They like that. This is what we call a police state. Intrusive government interference into your personal lives with lots of surveillance. Wherever you move, you'll be tracked; whatever call you make, you'll be tracked. In 2003, Britain passed the Online Safety Act, meaning if you say anything bad online, you can get arrested. So, freedom of expression is being limited.

In 2022 and 2023, this act passed in Britain but will likely spread to the western world. Digital currency aims for financial repression by eliminating cash, which allows freedom in transactions. With digital currency, all your transactions will be monitored and limited. In the future, you won't be able to buy video games because that's bad for you.

Microchip implants are coming next—after cell phones and facial recognition. Immigrants, lots of immigrants, are needed for various jobs: nurses, laborers, gardeners, lawn mowers. Massive immigration is coming into the country.

Good news: it'll be easier to study in America from now on. Trump announced he wants 600,000 Chinese students to go to the United States. Before, you were worried about not getting your visas and being denied at the border, but don't worry; they want you there because you're the best labor: cheap, obedient, studious, young.

This plan lets in more Chinese students so they can take care of elderly people. Lots of prisons are coming because elder people are afraid of criminals, who will be free labor. War after war after war is part of this. This means death by gerontocracy—living in a world governed by the elderly, who send young people to die for their glory.

Regarding young people overthrowing the system: there's nothing they can do because biologically, we respect and obey our elders. Old people are powerful and will control policy, diverting money from public schooling and healthcare into pensions. We'll have to support this due to respecting the elderly.

After rich pensioners die, their money is still a major political force. Eventually, there'll be a pension crisis with too many pensioners. The old will use their power to make trouble for everyone because we respect them, so denying healthcare and pensions isn't an option.
